holdout_protocol: Disjoint heldout episodes include a fixed online feedback prefix; final five probes never teach the policy.

paired_statistics.interpretation: Paired synthetic outcomes; p-value is descriptive only and does not adjust for within-seed or within-format dependence. At least five independent seed clusters are needed for a seed-level interval. No evidence of real LLM improvement without actual live-model experiments and larger heldout sets.

protocol.fixture_memory_ids: deterministic temporary SQLite IDs and equal created_at=1 ensure matched lexical ties
protocol.selection: validation probe hits; ties retain 3/relevance then smallest window and preregistered tie-break order

scope: Public synthetic deterministic fixture; CPU wall time, not model latency or scientific discovery.
